boundaries: First successful delayed completion used a native Update/Cancel click, production show-annotation event to reopen, and real textarea input. It was not a pointer hit-test on the stored note marker.

A first long-lock attempt used an awaited requestAnimationFrame loop and exceeded the bridge script timeout; releasing that lock let the pending write commit. It does not prove database timeout or retry. Covers commands were then also migrated and the final run sampled a nonblocking interval heartbeat separately.

Final lock sample after 6292 ms saw 118 heartbeat ticks, a preserved draft and localized database-busy message; recovery saved and closed the editor. SQL CLI injected only BEGIN IMMEDIATE/ROLLBACK, no row/schema mutations.

Final native binary includes the cover command migration; subsequent source-only repair restored multiline SQL literal indentation exactly to the prior source. Rust full suite was rerun afterward. No semantic operation body differences remained in the 98-command AST audit.

Native close success checked real Worker and actual Agent tool; no autonomous model inference. No newly created composition plugin in this unit. Existing real Worker fixture composed annotation and reading domains.

Boot initialization and native window-exit flush remain synchronous; this is not a claim that all native UI/FS/CPU work or OS-exit behavior is nonblocking. Blocking pool queue/memory bounds, maximum load, crash recovery, packaged, Windows/Linux and real multi-device sync remain unverified.
Whole-book annotation payload size, legacy unconditional mutation commands and the other matrix gaps remain. Overall goal is not complete.
